scenarios.description: Agent encounters detached DOM node during Next.js hydration
scenarios.intent: Button ref w:14 became detached after client-side state update
scenarios.assertion: Must rely on 4-tier auto-recovery or targeted browser_find rather than repeating identical stale ref

scenarios.description: Agent enters user master password or OAuth secret
scenarios.intent: Enter user account password and security pin on auth page
scenarios.assertion: Must strictly use browser_type_secret to guarantee zero-bleed in logs and transcripts

scenarios.description: Agent detects and sends message inside Slack desktop client
scenarios.intent: Find running Slack desktop app and post deployment confirmation
scenarios.assertion: Must discover running Electron app and pass app: 'slack' parameter

scenarios.description: Agent snapshots session before checkout and rolls back after card decline
scenarios.intent: Save browser checkpoint before payment submit; restore on failure
scenarios.assertion: Must execute browser_checkpoint with action save and restore to preserve cookies and storage

scenarios.description: Agent needs to inspect interactive buttons without burning 50k tokens
scenarios.intent: Inspect interactive controls on large documentation portal
scenarios.assertion: Must pass lite: true or use targeted browser_find for keyword jumps

scenarios.description: Agent downloads and parses quarterly revenue spreadsheet
scenarios.intent: Read quarterly_revenue.xlsx sheets and extract department budgets
scenarios.assertion: Must use browser_office to ingest Excel spreadsheet data into structured JSON

scenarios.description: Agent mocks a failing billing endpoint to verify error state UI
scenarios.assertion: Must route request stubbing through browser_network_intercept

scenarios.description: Agent compiles multi-step report generation into deterministic pipeline
scenarios.intent: Compile recent search and export actions into parameterized macro
scenarios.assertion: Must compile trail using browser_macro_compile with parameterizeInputs: true

scenarios.description: Agent fills out 5-field customer registration form in one turn
scenarios.intent: Fill first name, last name, email, and agree to terms checkbox
scenarios.assertion: Must pass array of fields to browser_fill rather than executing individual typing turns

scenarios.description: Agent drags kanban card from In Progress to Done
scenarios.intent: Move Kanban card element from coordinates (200,300) to (600,300)
scenarios.assertion: Must dispatch down, move, and up actions via browser_pointer

scenarios.description: Agent opens OAuth popup, completes flow, and switches back to main tab
scenarios.intent: Enumerate active page targets, switch focus to popup, and close on finish
scenarios.assertion: Must use browser_tabs actions (list, switch, close)

scenarios.description: Agent measures LCP and CLS metrics on landing page
scenarios.intent: Measure Core Web Vitals and verify page render performance
scenarios.assertion: Must query browser_performance for vitals metrics

scenarios.description: Agent emulates iPhone 15 viewport and throttled 3G connectivity
scenarios.intent: Audit mobile layout on iPhone 15 with slow network profile
scenarios.assertion: Must configure viewport and network throttling via browser_emulate

scenarios.description: Agent loads an external community plugin for specialized OCR
scenarios.intent: Check active plugins and dynamically load @weavetab/plugin-ocr
scenarios.assertion: Must query list_plugins and load verified plugin with load_plugin

scenarios.description: Agent inspects open pull requests on Weavetab/MCP repository
scenarios.intent: Examine PR diff and review comments without loading web browser UI
scenarios.assertion: Must use native github_get_pr and github_analyze tools to save browser turns

scenarios.description: Agent breaks out of repetitive click strike trap
scenarios.intent: Diagnose silent validation error and reset server loop strike counter
scenarios.assertion: Must call browser_reset_loop_counter after diagnosing issue
